# Incident Management Guideline

Version: 4.1

## Priority and Resolution Targets

| Priority | Description | Resolution target |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | Critical business service down | 4 hours |
| P2 | Major degradation | 8 hours |
| P3 | Minor issue | 3 business days |

## Escalation

A P1 incident is escalated to the duty manager at once.
